description: This PHP class 'MenuDao' provides data access methods for menu items in the OrangeHRM system, including enabling/disabling module menu items, retrieving menu items by module and screen, getting side panel and top menu items based on user roles, and fetching modules and menu items by specific criteria.

classes.name: MenuDao
classes.description: Data access object class for handling menu item database operations in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables specified menu items for a module by setting their status to active.

methods.name: updateStatusOfModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Internal method to update the status (enable/disable) of menu items for a given module, optionally filtered by menu titles.

methods.name: getMenuItemByModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves a MenuItem based on module name and screen name.

methods.name: getSidePanelMenuItems
methods.description: Fetches top-level menu items for the side panel filtered by user roles.

methods.name: getTopMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves second and third level menu items for the top menu based on user roles and a given side menu item ID.

methods.name: getMenuItemQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a query builder wrapper for fetching menu items filtered by user roles.

methods.name: getMenuItemByTitle
methods.description: Finds a menu item by its title, optionally filtered by level.

methods.name: getModuleByName
methods.description: Fetches a Module entity by its name.
